editorial: A silent alarm reverberates beneath the surf and pulls you into a world where every ripple hides a secret. Unlike conventional detective affairs, you find Conan steering through a covert naval platform that stitches global police feeds, turning sleuthing into a high‑stakes oceanic labyrinth. The film’s underwater sequences are captured with hyper‑realistic detail, turning each muted splash into a psychological battle that physically feels cool against the heat of tension. Some prolonged underwater interludes drag the tempo, occasionally letting suspense evaporate. Ideal for you if you love detective thrillers that bond artistic depth with relentless suspense.
